# Inside Higher Ed

> Inside Higher Ed is the leading news and career platform for higher education, covering faculty issues, institutional policy, and academic employment opportunities.

Inside Higher Ed provides comprehensive coverage of higher education news, policy debates, and career resources for faculty, administrators, and professionals in academia. The platform combines news aggregation with a robust job board featuring thousands of higher education positions and employer recruitment services.

## Key Topics

- Higher Education News
- Faculty Issues
- Academic Employment
- Tenure & Governance
- AI in Education
- Diversity & Equity
- Teaching & Learning
- Student Assessment
- Curriculum Development
- Contingent Faculty
- College Policy
- Academic Freedom
- Career Development
- Student Success
- Campus Governance

## Jobs & Careers

- [Inside Higher Ed Careers](https://careers.insidehighered.com): Job board with 22,897+ higher education career openings for faculty, administrators, and professional staff
- [Employer Services](https://recruiters.insidehighered.com): Recruitment platform for institutions and organizations to post higher education positions and manage hiring

## Faculty Issues & Governance

- [Faculty Issues](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/faculty-issues): Comprehensive coverage of faculty issues including academic freedom, governance, and employment rights
- [Tenure](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/faculty-issues/tenure): In-depth coverage of tenure policy, reform initiatives, and faculty employment protection
- [Contingent Faculty](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/faculty-issues/contingent-faculty): News and analysis on contingent and adjunct faculty employment, compensation, and working conditions
- [Career Development](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/faculty-issues/career-development): Faculty career advice, hiring practices, tenure processes, and professional development strategies
- [Diversity & Equity](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/faculty-issues/diversity-equity): Coverage of DEI initiatives, diversity policy, and equity issues affecting faculty and campus communities

## Teaching, Learning & Curriculum

- [Teaching](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/faculty-issues/teaching): Coverage of teaching methods, AI in education, classroom practices, and pedagogical innovation
- [Learning & Assessment](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/faculty-issues/learning-assessment): Analysis of student assessment methods, learning science research, and AI detection in education
- [Curriculum](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/faculty-issues/curriculum): Coverage of curriculum policy, course development, and academic program design in higher education

## News & Commentary

- [News](https://www.insidehighered.com/news): Higher education news aggregation, breaking stories, and article listings across all topics

## Core

- [Inside Higher Ed](https://www.insidehighered.com): Homepage providing access to higher education news, jobs, career advice, and events
